what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Colombia in Mexico: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3041 Colombian asylum seekers in Mexico, 1.0% of all asylum seekers from Colombia.
Refugees from Colombia, a separate group, live mostly in Ecuador, Venezuela, Canada and Costa Rica.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Colombia in every year from 1996 to 2025, with the ELN and FARC groups among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2022 to 2025, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2001 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 5131, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Mexico.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Mexico only.
